title: Acrobat Reader / PDF Viewer feature requirements
scope: Standalone desktop PDF viewer with Acrobat Reader-compatible viewing, forms, annotations, signatures, scripting, accessibility and printing. Advanced/conditional features are cataloged separately; paid editor and vendor-hosted authoring features are excluded.

viewer_scope_values.viewer_core: Expected in a full-featured desktop viewer
viewer_scope_values.advanced_or_conditional: Advanced, platform-dependent, document-dependent or service-dependent viewer behavior; requires explicit implementation decision
viewer_scope_values.optional_service: Cloud/service integration not required for offline viewer
viewer_scope_values.vendor_integration: Requires licensed or authorized vendor integration
viewer_scope_values.out_of_scope: Not part of the standalone viewer
